The Remarkable Pro Golfer!'') is the 11th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== {{spoilers}} * [[Kahili]] reveals she was attacked by a {{p|Buzzwole}} and {{p|Kartana}} shortly after arriving in [[Alola]]. * {{adv|Moon}} is revealed to be from [[Sinnoh]] and worked under [[Mr. Berlitz]]. * With [[Mallow]]'s help, Moon finds the [[Mirage Berry]]. * Mallow receives a call from [[Kiawe]], who was attacked by someone. * {{adv|Sun}} and [[Lana]] meet up with Moon and Mallow at [[Memorial Hill]], where they find Kiawe, lying on the ground defeated. * A group of {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s attack, claiming that they were the ones who defeated Kiawe. * Kiawe reveals that {{adv|Dollar}} is in possession of a [[Firium Z]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Buzzwole}} * {{p|Kartana}} * {{p|Oricorio}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Oricorio|Baile and Pom-Pom Styles}}) * {{p|Morelull}} * {{p|Oranguru}} * {{p|Bounsweet}} * {{p|Trumbeak}} * {{p|Passimian}} * {{p|Araquanid}} * {{p|Salazzle}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Hala]] * [[Kahili]] * [[Gladion]] (flashback) * [[Mr. Berlitz]] (flashback) * [[Roseanne]] (flashback) * {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s * {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s (video) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Cent]];
